## The largest finding isn't mathematical

**Batch 3's UCL source URL is dead.** `homepages.ucl.ac.uk/~ucahmki/2201notes.pdf` returns 404 with full browser headers; so does the whole directory; the Wayback Machine has no snapshot of it at any status, and the last archived copy of that directory (2026-02-11) is a research page with no teaching notes. **47 of the batch's 114 source rows rest on it, and 12 new items have no other backing** — including `thm-primary-decomposition-for-an-endomorphism` and `lem-coprime-kernel-decomposition`, the spine of page 88. `level-coverage` checks that a URL is *present*, not that it resolves, so 84 items would ship a dead link past a green gate. I'm not asserting the notes never existed — a search index still carries the title, and Kim did host UCL course notes there. Fix either way: **Treil LADW Ch. 4** for page 88 and **Axler LADR4e** for page 94 (both verified live; the Beta already read Axler).

## Two Statements claiming more than their proofs give

- **`cor-cayley-hamilton-recurrences-for-matrix-powers`** drops both hypotheses its source carries. Waldschmidt slide 18 says $A\in GL_d(K)$, *nonzero determinant* — and the page's own recurrence definition needs $c_d\ne0$, which is $\pm\det A$. A nilpotent $A$ falsifies the unqualified title. The cited `thm-cayley-hamilton` is also field-only while the item sits in a commutative-ring page.
- **`prop-reciprocity-for-biinfinite-linear-recurrences`** states its conclusion in $K(x)$, which order 195 cannot reach. Stanley appends a *Note* that this is precisely an equality of rational functions, not power series. Remedy: add `the-field-of-fractions-and-localisation` (order 53.2, published) — I simulated it, **zero seams**.

## Missing standard results, each with a live source

Two appear in **no** source's contents at all: the **multiplicity criterion for diagonalisability** (Treil Thm 4.2.8; both ingredients already published and in closure) and **least squares / the normal equation** (Treil §5.4, one section inside the chapter already harvested). Two more sit *inside* declared page ranges with no disposition row — Conrad Cor 5.5 and Stanley Ex 4.7.5 — a locator pattern `coverage-checklist.mjs` structurally cannot see, which I've flagged for the other groups.

Every locator I could open verified: Conrad, Treil, Stanley, Sagan, Waldschmidt and Gallier all check out at their stated pages. And **134 of 134 published-citation quotes across both batches match their item files verbatim**.
